quarterly_data.quarter: Wärtsilä press release: Wrtsil, Schneider Electric and Stanley Consultants launch (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Wärtsilä, Schneider Electric and Stanley Consultants launched a coordinated 'Generator-to-Chip' approach for U.S. data center developers and operators: Wärtsilä provides modular engine power plants for onsite generation, Schneider Electric the integrated electrical architecture, automation and digital power management, and Stanley Consultants engineering, permitting, design coordination, construction management and commissioning oversight; the companies say it can accelerate project schedules compared with sequential delivery models (no order or customer is named). Risto Paldanius, Vice President, Americas, Wärtsilä Energy: 'For many data center projects, power has become the schedule.'
